CheckTitle: EventBridge event bus policy permits public access
Description: EventBridge event bus resource policies allow public or anonymous access through broad principals such as Principal '*' or similarly unrestricted permissions.
Risk: Public access to an EventBridge event bus can allow unauthenticated or unintended external principals to publish events or interact with the bus. Attackers may inject malicious events into event-driven workflows, trigger downstream actions, manipulate application behavior, or generate unexpected resource usage and costs.

Recommendation.Text: Remove statements that grant public or anonymous access to the event bus. Restrict access to trusted AWS accounts, IAM principals, or AWS Organizations where cross-account access is required, and scope permissions to the minimum required actions and events.
